title: Quentin and the Alibi
author: Elodie Crane
blurb: Yara Thackeray, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
